study: Test causal-graph exploration decision selection from only own authentic public observations and original selected action consequences, not map/navigation oracle. Replace repeated exposure-frame proxy with distinct public observation-context opportunity and authentic environment goal metrics. No scientific promotion.

design.information: only source public 7x7x3 image, direction, literal mission and own previously selected action/successor/reward; no pose/coordinates, inventory, map, external planner, reward shaping or scripted rule
design.lookahead_policy: Maintain own observed deterministic selected public-context/action/successor-count graph. Prefer a local previously untried action. If none, find shallow length<=3 graph paths to public contexts with untried actions, choose observed first action maximizing path novelty/inverse visit and penalizing self-loop. Search only empirically observed graph edges. Never use mission target/door/key route, reward or future episode oracle.
design.cold_source_memory: each role retains only its own authenticated selected source experience for subsequent seeds within one family; no cross-arm or cross-family leakage; RNG control independent
design.source_seed_lineage: new exposed DEV seeds cross-check parent reachable source and known published MG17/21/22/24/31/33. Does not certify unknown private/unindexed branches.
design.resource_limits: same 192 actual actions/episode; report selected action counts and host CPU/wall, full Go subprocess CPU/RSS parity unqualified; science not eligible without separately qualified parity

preregistered_outcomes.target_front: source original public image front [3][5] exactly mission target type and color, before selected action; count frames AND distinct full public context sha256
preregistered_outcomes.locked_door_front: original front door type4 state2 before selected action; count frames AND distinct full public context sha256; not proof of usable key
preregistered_outcomes.pickup_attempt_and_effect: selected action3 while exact target in front; original after front becomes empty with unchanged heading for actual effect
preregistered_outcomes.toggle_and_open: selected action5 while locked door in front; original after state2->0 with same door type/color and heading
preregistered_outcomes.positive_goal: real original positive reward and terminated
preregistered_outcomes.context_unique: sha256(public image,direction); distinct observations, not proven distinct geographic regions
preregistered_outcomes.other: per role/family original selected action total, no-change frames, unique exact mission-target contexts, unique locked-door-front contexts, cold checkpoint continuation and goal episodes

development_success_filter.required: candidate distinct target-front contexts across unfamiliar families > every matched baseline, candidate positive goal episodes >= each matched baseline +1, candidate actual target effects >= 1, and at least 2 distinct original family goal successes. All conditions; no endpoint reweighting after seeing data.
development_success_filter.always: no held-out/transfer conclusion, no native model promotion; negative preserved if failure
